interface.begin_replace: Positive coordinate/face counts independently resize owned flattened vectors, keeping prefix and appending zero. Nonpositive counts are no-ops for that vector. Effective positive face count freshly zeros classification storage and resizes aux68 with prefix/zero growth. Plane list remains unchanged until finalization.
interface.rows: write_coordinate and write_face use zero-based checked row positions; flat mutable spans allow importer partial writes. Class does not parse lines or set object flags.
interface.finalize_planes: Caller establishes object3990 enable. Clear/reseed plane list then finite3D grouping. Optional copied plane IDs/origins/normals preserved; new IDs fill first positive gap. No model-source plane list lookup is implemented.
interface.observation: Counts derived from flattened vector lengths. Read spans cover coordinate/connectivity/classification/aux68, plus const Plane vector with id/origin/normal.
interface.reset: Selected virtual+0x10=2f92b0 clears coordinates/connectivity/classification/aux68 but retains plane list. Original additionally resets unmodeled48,60,70,78.
interface.deactivate: 2f9340->2fcde0 clears all five represented vectors. Original additionally clears unmodeled subrecords40,50,58; their effects are not claimed.
interface.flags: GeometryStorage does not own object3990 or3994.15fbf0 explicitly clears3990; no direct3994 clear is present in that dossier. Parent must preserve field ownership.

exact_behavior: SSE binary64 arithmetic association represented explicitly; compiler-specific contraction disabling pragmas, no fast-math compatibility.
Bounding diagonal uses all points, positive-coordinate-and-face gates, min+1e30/max-1e30 sentinels, <= tie behavior, accumulator0+xÂ²+yÂ²+zÂ² then sqrt.
Cross product uses(C-B)x(A-B), normalized only when magnitude!=0. Magnitude of normalized result is recomputed for>=1e-6 gate.
First insertion-order plane satisfying oriented normal squared distance<0.01 and absolute point-plane distance<0.001*diagonal wins.
Classification=id+600; skipped fourthslot>=1 and degenerate triangles retain prior bytes.

defined_domain_and_limits: Finite coordinate and copied-plane inputs only. Check finite intermediate differences/products/sums/divisions; throw domain_error on overflow/nonfinite results rather than claiming CRT special-value compatibility.
Signed32 count multiplication must fit: coordinate_count<=INT32_MAX/3 and face_count<=INT32_MAX/4. Oversized positive counts throw length_error before resizing; nonpositive counts remain no-op.

Eligible faces require first three positive IDs within coordinate count. Check before unsafe coordinate access; malformed-input native behavior not reproduced. Skipped positive-fourthslot faces do not dereference indices.
Plane ID exhaustion or id+600 overflow throws overflow_error; native wrap/undefined resource behavior not reproduced.
Resource failure and excluded-domain exceptions are not transactional. Owned allocation/pointer addresses/capacities/free timing and original reference-counted sharing are not reproduced.
Subnormal intermediate behavior assumes matching default floating environment; underflow, nonfinite, NaN payloads, FP exceptions and alternate rounding modes are not validated.
Source/destination aliasing in optional plane copy is made safe by taking a copy; no claim of reproducing original aliased list behavior.
